title: Little People Collectibles Keep Selling Out & This ‘Frozen’ Set Is the Latest to Catch the Attention of Collectors
summary: More than 1,000 of these Frozen Little People sets are selling on Amazon each month. Shop the hot commodity online.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Some Little People sets are toys, while others become instant collector favorites, like Disney’s Frozen nine-figure set. The franchise behind the Billboard Hot 100 top five hit “Let It Go” teamed up with Fisher-Price on an Amazon-exclusive set featuring a carry-along castle case packed with nine characters: Anna, Elsa, Olaf, Kristoff, Sven, Grand Pabbie, Bulda, Pebble and Marshmallow. With more than a thousand purchased in the past month, the Frozen Little People set is one of many music-themed releases demonstrating the popularity of these tiny figures.

The official *NSYNC Little People Collector set , for instance, quickly became a standout music release, selling out almost immediately as ’90s nostalgia fueled demand. The Britney Spears Little People Collector set likewise drew attention, featuring four figures inspired by some of her most recognizable music-video looks. And as KPop Demon Hunters merch continues its commercial takeover, its Little People Collector sets have been flying off the shelves too. Beyond music, the Gilmore Girls Little People and Kansas City Chiefs Collector sets also sold out rapidly following their respective launches.

FROZEN

Fisher-Price Little People Disney Frozen Carry Along Castle Case

1K Bought This Month

$54.99

Buy Now on amazon

Each figure in this Frozen Little People set is sized for small hands, while the portable case opens into a castle-themed playset with a dedicated space for each character. A built-in handle makes the set easy to carry, and the format supports imaginative storytelling and fine-motor practice for children ages 18 months and up. Recent Amazon sales estimates also indicate strong demand, so collectors should act quickly while stocks last.

MUSICAL VERSION

Fisher-Price Little People Elsa’s Ice Palace From Frozen

200+ Bought This Month

$49.67

Collectors and young Frozen fans can also add Elsa’s ice palace musical playset to the lineup.

This Amazon exclusive features Elsa and Olaf alongside a bed and chair accessory. The interactive palace incorporates lights and sounds, plus “Let It Go,” giving the collectible a musical component. One button reveals a staircase with lights and sounds, while another button expands the castle with a spinning snowflake feature. Designed for children ages 18 months to 5 years, the set combines pretend play with storytelling and fine-motor activities.
